mapper.sql: select dictionaryData.id, dictionaryData.dict_sort, dictionaryData.dict_label, dictionaryData.dict_value, dictionaryType.dict_name as dictTypeName, dictionaryData.dict_type, dictionaryData.css_class, dictionaryData.list_class, dictionaryData.is_default, dictionaryData.status, dictionaryData.tenant_id, dictionaryData.revision, dictionaryData.created_by, dictionaryData.created_time, dictionaryData.updated_by, dictionaryData.updated_time, dictionaryData.deleted_flag, dictionaryData.deleted_by, dictionaryData.deleted_time, dictionaryData.remark, dictionaryData.organization_id, dictionaryData.department_id from system_dictionary_data as dictionaryData left join system_dictionary_type as dictionaryType on dictionaryData.dict_type = dictionaryType.dict_type
